string.name: text
string.value: #e1. What is SlumsMS?#n

string.name: text
string.value: SlumsMS has #bcustom jobs and skills#k, rebirths, the Arcane River and Grandis maps, and a 5th tier for every class.\n\nOn top of that the towns are alive. Thousands of #bregulars#k train, trade, chat, run party quests and come and go through the day.

string.name: text
string.value:
#eGood to know#n
- One world, #bBera#k, 5 channels.
- The #bTRADE#k button takes you to the hub, #bBase of Roots#k.
- The #bSHOP#k button opens the cash shop in a window.
- Day, night and weather change on outdoor maps.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e2. Rates#n

string.name: text
string.value:
#bEXP#k 3x #bMeso#k 10x
#bDrop#k 4x #bBoss drop#k 3x

Quest mesos follow the meso rate. NPC shop prices are normal, so potions and stars are cheap for you.

Party play and party quests give bonus EXP.

Type #b@rates#k to see your own rates.

string.name: text
string.value:
#eAfter a rebirth#n your EXP rate changes:
- No rebirth: 3x
- 1st rebirth: 3x
- 2nd rebirth: 2x
- 3rd rebirth: 1x

The numbers on this page can change between updates. #b@rates#k always shows the real ones.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e3. Base of Roots and the FM#n

string.name: text
string.value: #bBase of Roots#k is the main hub. The #bTRADE#k button takes you there. The Job Master, the rebirth NPC, the warper and storage are all in it.\n\nThe #bclassic Free Market#k is still here: use its portal in the hub, or the FM portal in any town. Leaving the FM takes you back where you came in.

string.name: text
string.value:
#eIn the Free Market#n you'll find player shops and the town's merchants. Their prices are on the shop sign; buy as you would from anyone.

Fredrick holds what your hired merchant didn't sell.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e4. Hub NPCs#n

string.name: text
string.value:
#bJob Master#k - job advances; skips the test for a fee.
#bWyatt the Reborn#k - rebirths.
#bKey Binder#k - past-life skills on your keys, 100 SP per rebirth.
#bCotton Warper#k - boss maps, Grandis and Arcane towns.
#b4th job skills#k - quest/book 4th job skills of your lines, 50m mesos.

string.name: text
string.value:
#bNimble#k - forge equipment, refine ores.
#bRooty#k - NX goodies, donor items, mastery books.
#bCotton Stylist#k - hair, face, skin.
#bGerrard#k - storage.
#bLab Tech#k - your expedition (boss) attempts.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e5. Jobs and the Job Master#n

string.name: text
string.value:
The #bJob Master#k skips the job test for a fee. Your class instructor's test is free.

1st job: level 10 (Magician 8), free
2nd job: level 30, 4m
3rd job: level 70, 75m
4th job: level 120, 500m

Cygnus Knights get a 4th job too. A Beginner can choose #bSuper Beginner#k at level 10 from the Job Master.

string.name: text
string.value:
SlumsMS changed many skills: new 4th job attacks, more lines and targets, and some old skills removed (boosters, Steal, Big Bang and others).

Warriors are sword or spear only.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e6. Rebirths#n

string.name: text
string.value:
At #blevel 200#k you can be reborn (up to 3 times). You start again at level 1 as a Beginner, Noblesse or Legend, and keep your past jobs' skills.

Talk to #bWyatt the Reborn#k with an Essence Stone:
1st: #bBlue#k 2nd: #bRed#k 3rd: #bBlack#k

string.name: text
string.value:
#eStones are made from:#n
Blue: Zakum Diamond + Nine Spirit's Egg
Red: Rock of Time + Von Leon's Seal
Black: Cygnus Circlet + Cygnus Knight Emblem

#eRebirths open maps:#n
1: Lion King's Castle
2: Twilight Perion
3: Grandis and Arcane River

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e7. The 5th tier#n

string.name: text
string.value:
Every 4th job has a #b5th tier#k with four new skills.

You need:
- your 4th job,
- #b3 rebirths#k,
- #bWorld's Engine#k (used up).

Then talk to the #bJob Master#k.

string.name: text
string.value:
#bWorld's Engine#k comes from the quest #bMagnus the Tyrant!#k: level 200, defeat Magnus, then report to Wyatt the Reborn.

A Super Beginner at level 120 with 3 rebirths and World's Engine can become a #bSynth Master#k.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e8. The town's regulars#n

string.name: text
string.value: Bera is busy. Its regulars train on the maps for their level, ride the boats, sell in the FM, shout on megaphones and drift in and out through the day.\n\nSome keep shops, run the gacha, deal blackjack or host games in Henesys. Most are happy to chat.

string.name: text
string.value:
They remember you. Party, help, trade and fame them and they become friends; KS them or be rude and they become rivals.

Friends sometimes give gifts. See chapter 13.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e9. Talking to people#n

string.name: text
string.value: Say someone's #bname#k (or part of it) in chat. They answer in a chat bubble.\n\nAfter that they keep listening to you for about a minute, so you don't have to repeat the name. Walk away, change maps or talk to someone else and they stop.

string.name: text
string.value:
#eThings to ask:#n
#b<name> party#k - if they say yes, send the invite.
#b<name> where do u train#k
#b<name> follow#k - a party member comes with you.
#b<name> how much for <item>#k - buy and haggle.

#bDouble-click#k someone for their menu. You can #bwhisper#k them too.

string.name: text
string.value: #e10. Megaphones and @quiet#n

string.name: text
string.value:
Megaphones carry big news: boss kills, rare drops, party quests forming.

Too noisy? Only for you:
#b@quiet megaphones#k
#b@quiet bots#k - hide the regulars' chatter
#b@quiet all#k
#b@quiet off#k

Real players and GM notices always show.

string.name: text
string.value:
People you are talking to or partied with still show when their chatter is hidden.

Your @quiet choice is kept.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e11. Commands#n

string.name: text
string.value:
#b@help#k - all commands
#b@guide#k - the quick tour
#b@rates#k / #b@check#k - rates, resets
#b@online#k - who is on
#b@str @dex @int @luk <n>#k - add AP
#b@whodrops <item>#k
#b@whatdropsfrom <mob>#k
#b@mobhp#k / #b@bosshp#k

string.name: text
string.value:
#b@qs#k - quick sell
#b@bb#k - buy back
#b@bank#k - store mesos
#b@weekly#k - boss attempts
#b@ranks#k / #b@equiplv#k
#b@shop#k - all-in-one shop
#b@settings#k - bot settings
#b@goto <town>#k - hop to a town
#b@dispose#k - fix a stuck NPC chat

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e12. Getting help#n

string.name: text
string.value:
#b@gm <message>#k - message the GMs.
#b@bug <text>#k - report a bug.
#b@idea <text>#k - suggest something.
#b@dispose#k - if an NPC window is stuck.

Game won't start? Make your real monitor the #bmain display#k (Parsec and other virtual screens stop it).

string.name: text
string.value: Have fun, and say hi to the regulars.\n\n#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e13. Friends, rivals, romance#n

string.name: text
string.value: Every regular has a feeling about you. Party, buffs, heals, trades, gifts and fame make #bfriends#k: they greet you, invite you and may send a gift.\n\nKS, taking drops or rude chat make #brivals#k: trash talk and a few stolen mobs. Grudges fade over weeks.

string.name: text
string.value:
#b@settings#k - switch it all with a click.
#b@botdrama off#k - no rivals for you.
#b@romance on#k - they may flirt and date you (off by default). Marry in #bAmoria#k.

Add them as #bbuddies#k. Ten #bbot guilds#k recruit and go to war: #b@guildwar#k.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e14. Gachapon, shops, @price#n

string.name: text
string.value:
#bGachapon#k machines stand in 12 towns, each with its own prizes. #b@gacha <town>#k lists them.

Tickets: #bHanako#k in the FM Entrance (3m mesos) or the Cash Shop.

#b@price <item>#k - what it really sold for this week.

string.name: text
string.value:
Up to 8 regulars keep shops in FM rooms 1-12 on channels 1-3.

To buy, ask: #b"how much for the work gloves"#k. To sell, invite them to trade. Haggle in chat; friends pay less.

Shops pay a #b3%#k tax on sales.

#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l

string.name: text
string.value: #e15. Getting around#n

string.name: text
string.value:
#b@goto <town>#k hops to a town (not from events, PQs or maps you can't leave). #b@goto#k lists them.

Channel 1 is the busiest, channel 5 the quietest.

The #bDaily Check-In#k gives a gift each day from level 10: #b@daily#k.

string.name: text
string.value: #eBounces#n: Thieves and Night Walkers keep the strong Ninja and Vertical Bounce. Everyone else gets a Flash Jump-sized one. Ninja Bounce works only in the air.\n\n#L0##bBack to Contents#k#l
